Name: Content Patcher - Custom Abigail (Portrait and Sprite)
Author: Seyph
Description:
Redesign of Abigail's portrait and sprite (no bowlegs). Has config file for 4 different hair and bow options.

Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

Hair colors:
[list]
[*]purple (default)
[*]teal
[*]brown
[*]black
[/list]Bow:
[list]
[*]none (default)
[*]green
[*]magenta
[*]blue
[/list]
